number_of_shares.title: Number of shares
number_of_shares.description: The share/unit quantity for this sale line, printed in the leftmost 'Number of shares' column headed '(Box 5)' (IRS Form 1099-B Box 5, 'No. of shares exchanged'). JSON number exactly as printed, e.g. 4.0000, 249.6460, 82.3900; null if the column is blank on the row.

cusip.title: CUSIP
cusip.description: The 9-character security identifier printed in the 'CUSIP' column headed '(Box 1b)' (IRS Form 1099-B Box 1b, 'CUSIP no.'). Verbatim as printed, e.g. 25179M103, H27013100. Identifies the row: transaction rows are aligned by CUSIP at eval time, not by position; when the same CUSIP has several lots/sale dates the rows are matched in printed order within that CUSIP. Null only if the security prints no CUSIP.

description.title: Description
description.description: The security description printed in the 'Description' column headed '(Box 7)' (IRS Form 1099-B Box 7). Verbatim as printed, joining a wrapped two-line name with a single space, e.g. 'DEVON ENERGY CORP COM', 'DREYFUS BOSTON CO SMALLCAP EQTY TE'.

date_acquired.title: Date Acquired
date_acquired.description: The acquisition date printed in the 'Date Acquired' column (a broker supplemental column; no IRS box). Verbatim as printed: either a date like '02/27/2009' or the literal word 'VARIOUS' when multiple lots were acquired; null if blank.

date_of_sale.title: Date of Sale
date_of_sale.description: The sale/disposition date printed in the 'Date of Sale' column headed '(Box 1a)' (IRS Form 1099-B Box 1a, 'Date of sale or exchange'). Verbatim as printed, e.g. '09/09/2009'; the literal 'VARIOUS' if the statement prints it; null if blank.

proceeds.title: Proceeds (Stocks, bonds, etc.)
proceeds.description: The sale proceeds printed in the 'Stocks Bonds, etc.' column headed '(Box 2)' (IRS Form 1099-B Box 2, 'Stocks, bonds, etc.'). JSON number exactly as printed with the thousands comma removed, e.g. 258.17, 4061.08; null if blank.

cost_or_other_basis.title: Cost or other Basis
cost_or_other_basis.description: The cost basis printed in the 'Cost or other Basis' column (a broker supplemental column; not an IRS-reported box on the 2009 form). JSON number exactly as printed, e.g. 177.15, 3499.47; null if blank.

net_gain_or_loss.title: Net Gain or Loss
net_gain_or_loss.description: The gain/loss printed in the 'Net Gain or Loss' column (a broker supplemental column; no IRS box). JSON number exactly as printed; a loss prints with a leading minus and is negative, e.g. 81.02, -31.21, -3636.11; null if blank.

federal_income_tax_withheld.title: Federal Income Tax Withheld
federal_income_tax_withheld.description: The backup withholding printed in the rightmost 'Federal Income Tax Withheld' column headed '(Box 4)' (IRS Form 1099-B Box 4). JSON number exactly as printed, usually 0.00; null if the column is blank.

section_label.title: Section label
section_label.description: The label of a printed section-summary line, verbatim, e.g. 'Total Short Term Sales Reported on 1099-B', 'Long Term 15% Sales Reported on 1099-B', 'Total Long Term Sales Reported on 1099-B'. Identifies the row; these summary lines are NOT transactions (they carry no CUSIP or share count) and must not be placed in the transactions array. A section header printed with no totals on this page still yields a row with null amounts.

proceeds.title: Subtotal proceeds
proceeds.description: The section total in the 'Stocks Bonds, etc.' / '(Box 2)' column for this summary line; JSON number, comma removed; null if not printed.

cost_or_other_basis.title: Subtotal cost or other basis
cost_or_other_basis.description: The section total in the 'Cost or other Basis' column for this summary line; JSON number; null if not printed.

net_gain_or_loss.title: Subtotal net gain or loss
net_gain_or_loss.description: The section total in the 'Net Gain or Loss' column for this summary line; JSON number, negative for a net loss; null if not printed.

federal_income_tax_withheld.title: Subtotal federal income tax withheld
federal_income_tax_withheld.description: The section total in the 'Federal Income Tax Withheld' / '(Box 4)' column for this summary line; JSON number; null if not printed.

title: Form 1099-B Proceeds From Broker and Barter Exchange Transactions (2009 consolidated statement)

payer_name.title: Payer name
payer_name.description: The payer/broker name printed under 'Payer's Name and Address' at the top-left, verbatim; join multiple name lines with a single space, e.g. 'SUNTRUST BANK W&IM TAX SERVICES', 'GIBRALTAR PRIVATE BANK & TRUST'.

payer_address.title: Payer address
payer_address.description: The payer/broker mailing address printed under 'Payer's Name and Address', below the name line(s); join street and city/state/ZIP lines with ', ', e.g. 'P.O. BOX 1908, ORLANDO, FL 32802-1908'.

payer_phone.title: Payer phone
payer_phone.description: The payer telephone number printed on the 'Questions?' line in the header, verbatim as printed, e.g. '(305)476-1982'; null when the statement variant prints no phone.

payer_federal_id.title: Payer's Federal ID number
payer_federal_id.description: The payer TIN printed beside 'Payer's Federal ID number', verbatim including the hyphen, e.g. '59-3482833'.

account_number.title: Account Number
account_number.description: The brokerage account number printed beside 'Account Number:', verbatim, e.g. '5630064', '0920035'.

recipient_name.title: Recipient name
recipient_name.description: The recipient name printed under 'Recipient's Name and Address', verbatim (first name line before the address), e.g. 'THE GOYEN FOUNDATION INC.', 'ROGER WINFIELD SCOTT FOUNDATION, INC'.

recipient_address.title: Recipient address
recipient_address.description: The recipient mailing address printed under 'Recipient's Name and Address', below the name; join the street and city/state/ZIP lines with ', ', e.g. '104 RIVERSIDE DRIVE #205C, COCOA, FL 32922'.

recipient_tax_id.title: Recipient's Tax ID number
recipient_tax_id.description: The recipient TIN printed beside 'Recipient's Tax ID number', verbatim including the hyphen, e.g. '59-3338187', '58-0655183'.

corrected.title: Corrected
corrected.description: The 'Corrected' checkbox in the header. TWO-STATE: true only if a mark is printed inside the box; false otherwise, including when this statement leaves it blank (the usual case). Never return null for this field.

second_tin_notice.title: 2nd TIN notice
second_tin_notice.description: The '2nd TIN notice' checkbox in the header. TWO-STATE: true only if a mark is printed inside the box; false otherwise, including blank (the usual case). Never return null for this field.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: Every individual sale line in the 1099-B proceeds table on this page, in printed top-to-bottom order. Each row carries a CUSIP '(Box 1b)' and share count '(Box 5)'. Do NOT include section-summary lines such as 'Total Short Term Sales Reported on 1099-B' here — those go in section_subtotals. Null only if the page prints no transaction rows.

section_subtotals.title: Section subtotals
section_subtotals.description: The section-summary lines printed on this page (e.g. 'Total Short Term Sales Reported on 1099-B', 'Long Term 15% Sales Reported on 1099-B'), each with its column totals. Null when the page prints no summary line (most mid-section pages).
